input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3 and the 19.4 remedy (re-performance, repair, replacement, then refund) and the 19.5 disclaimer carve-out are all sound and do not swallow the express warranties. The material failure is Section 19.2: a fifteen-day conformance period running from delivery, with an express statement that Vendor has no correction or refund obligation thereafter, falls below even the fallback of 90 days for software / 30 days for services. It is also shorter than the fifteen-business-day acceptance testing window in Section 6.1, so the warranty can lapse before Customer has finished testing, and the cut-off risks neutralising the Section 19.4 remedy for the general conformance warranty in 19.1. Redline extends the period to ninety days from acceptance and deletes the cut-off, preserving the existing 19.4 remedy.

proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty from 15 days to 90 days after acceptance and delete the cut-off of Vendor's correction/refund obligation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Deliverable conformance warranty to ninety days running from acceptance and removed the language cutting off Vendor's correction and refund obligation, since a fifteen-day period expires before the fifteen-business-day acceptance window in Section 6.1 even closes. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for deliverables/services with repair, replacement or refund; we can discuss a shorter period if it still runs from acceptance and preserves the Section 19.4 remedy.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after acceptance, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and the specifications in the applicable Order Form, and Vendor will correct any nonconformity reported during that period in accordance with Section 19.4.
